About Us
DEPT. OF SOCIAL SERVICES
The Division of Economic Assistance promotes the wellbeing of and provides support for families, children, individuals, elderly and persons with disabilities. The Division of Economic Assistance provides medical, nutritional and financial services. Division staff also provide assessment and referrals to other state, federal and local resources.
